[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [ValidateSet('Editor', 'Game')]
    [string]$Target = 'Editor',

    [ValidateSet('Debug', 'DebugGame', 'Development', 'Shipping', 'Test')]
    [string]$Configuration = 'Development',

    [string]$Module,
    [string[]]$EnablePlugin = @(),
    [string]$ProjectRoot,
    [string]$EngineRoot = 'C:\Program Files\Epic Games\UE_5.8',
    [ValidateRange(5, 3600)]
    [int]$QueueTimeoutSeconds = 5,
    [switch]$AllowLongQueueWait,
    [ValidateRange(30, 14400)]
    [Alias('BuildTimeoutSeconds')]
    [int]$BuildStallTimeoutSeconds = 1800,
    [ValidateRange(1, 60)]
    [int]$BuildProgressPollSeconds = 5,
    [ValidateRange(1, 2)]
    [int]$MaxParallelActions = 2,
    [ValidateRange(1, 1000000)]
    [int]$HardPageReadsPerSecond = 512,
    [ValidateRange(1, 500)]
    [int]$MinFreeDiskGB = 25,
    [ValidateRange(1, 500)]
    [int]$WarnFreeDiskGB = 40,
    [ValidateRange(0, 500)]
    [int]$ReserveDiskGB = 8,
    [switch]$ValidationOnly,
    [switch]$PlanOnly
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Set-StrictMode -Version Latest

$isGitHubActions = [string]::Equals([string]$env:GITHUB_ACTIONS, 'true', [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)
if ($QueueTimeoutSeconds -gt 5 -and (-not $AllowLongQueueWait -or -not $isGitHubActions)) {
    [Console]::Error.WriteLine("P3_BUILD_ROUTE_BLOCKED phase=queue-policy reason=LONG_QUEUE_WAIT_CI_ONLY timeout_seconds=$QueueTimeoutSeconds github_actions=$isGitHubActions CONTINUE_OTHER_SCOPE=YES")
    exit 124
}

$buildAdmissionHelper = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'ci\control\P3BuildAdmission.ps1'
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $buildAdmissionHelper -PathType Leaf)) {
    throw "P3_BUILD_ADMISSION_HELPER_MISSING=$buildAdmissionHelper"
}
. $buildAdmissionHelper
$buildAdmissionDiagnosticHelper = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'ci\control\P3BuildAdmissionDiagnostic.ps1'
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $buildAdmissionDiagnosticHelper -PathType Leaf)) {
    throw "P3_BUILD_ADMISSION_DIAGNOSTIC_HELPER_MISSING=$buildAdmissionDiagnosticHelper"
}
. $buildAdmissionDiagnosticHelper
$singleFlightHelper = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'ci\control\P3BuildSingleFlight.ps1'
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $singleFlightHelper -PathType Leaf)) {
    throw "P3_BUILD_SINGLEFLIGHT_HELPER_MISSING=$singleFlightHelper"
}
. $singleFlightHelper
$buildProgressHelper = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'ci\control\P3BuildProgress.ps1'
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $buildProgressHelper -PathType Leaf)) {
    throw "P3_BUILD_PROGRESS_HELPER_MISSING=$buildProgressHelper"
}
. $buildProgressHelper
$buildQueueRetryHelper = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'ci\control\P3BuildQueueRetry.ps1'
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $buildQueueRetryHelper -PathType Leaf)) {
    throw "P3_BUILD_QUEUE_RETRY_HELPER_MISSING=$buildQueueRetryHelper"
}
. $buildQueueRetryHelper

if (-not $ProjectRoot) {
    $ProjectRoot = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
}
$ProjectRoot = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($ProjectRoot)

# Ordinary worker lanes are source workspaces, not separate Unreal build installations.
# New-P3Lane marks them explicitly so branch-local Intermediate/Binaries cannot regrow
# behind the shared persistent hot-source pool. CI clones, hot-build workspaces, editor
# workspaces and the primary checkout are not source-class and continue through normally.
$workspaceClass = ''
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $ProjectRoot '.git')) {
    $savedWorkspaceEap = $ErrorActionPreference
    try {
        $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
        $workspaceClass = ((& git -C $ProjectRoot config --worktree --get p3.workspaceClass 2>$null) | Out-String).Trim()
    }
    finally { $ErrorActionPreference = $savedWorkspaceEap }
}
if (-not $workspaceClass -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $ProjectRoot '.git') -PathType Leaf)) {
    $branch = ((& git -C $ProjectRoot branch --show-current 2>$null) | Out-String).Trim()
    $hotWrapper = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'Invoke-P3HotSourceBuild.ps1'
